To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
the coverage algorithm for wireless sensor networks does not work for video-based sensor networks.
the sensor network algorithm is not able to provide the expected coverage preservation of monitored regions in video-based networks, because of the unique characteristics of the cameras.

(1) the algorithm designed for traditional sensor networks does not preserve the coverage in the video-based network, (2) the reason is the different way that video sensors capture information and (3) the algorithm can be modified to preserve the coverage.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the coverage problem in wireless sensor networks.
the coverage problem in a video-based sensor network.
the coverage problem in a network of cameras.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that

the coverage problem in a video-based network is different from that in a traditional network, and it is not enough to simply apply the coverage algorithm designed for traditional networks to a video-based network.
video-based sensor networks have a different nature and behavior from traditional wireless sensor networks.
the coverage problem in wireless sensor networks (WSNs) is a challenging problem that has been widely studied in recent years.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the way cameras capture information is very different from the way sensors in traditional wireless sensor networks capture information.

we have analyzed the behavior of a sensor network protocol in a video-based sensor network, and we have shown that the protocol does not give the same results that it does in traditional sensor networks.
the sensor network algorithm is not suitable for video-based networks, but it is not clear how to design an algorithm that is suitable for these networks, since the problem is not fully understood.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the networking perspective is as important as the visual one for the development of these types of networks.
the coverage problem in traditional wireless sensor networks does not necessarily lead to the same solution in video-based networks, which have unique features that need to be considered.
the networking algorithms designed for traditional wireless networks are not suitable for video-based wireless sensor network, which require specific protocols to be designed.
